Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  November 15, 2023

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on November 15, 2023.
Commissioner Metcalf called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the flag salute.

Stephanie Maldonado announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1, Commissioner Phyllis
  Battle ‐ District 3, Commissioner Vicki Perryman-Banks - District 4,
  Commissioner Jacques Lesure - Commissioner at Large

  Absent:  Commissioner Olivia Alvitre – District 2

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Thomas Uwal  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Helen Lessick  Public Art Consultant
  Stephanie Maldonado  Senior Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

STAFF REPORT. A staff report dated November 15, 2023, recommending the Arts
Commission recommend to the Mayor and City Council that RLA Conservation, LLC be
contracted in the amount of $9,196 to research, recommend and, on approval,
implement treatments for the Incomplete Conch Shell by Jack Zajac. Silverlake
Conservation, LLC is the alternate vendor.

It was moved by Commissioner Battle and seconded by Commissioner Banks that the Arts
Commission hereby approves the recommendation. The motion was carried by the
following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Lesure, Battle, Banks and Metcalf
Noes: None

  1
   Arts Commission

STAFF REPORT. A staff report dated November 15, 2023, recommending the Arts
Commission recommend to the Mayor and City Council that RLA Conservation, LLC be
contracted in the amount of $86,933 to research, recommend and, on approval,
implement cleaning and conservation treatments for The History of Transportation by
Helen Lundeberg. The alternate is SCS Conservation LLC.

It was moved by Commissioner Lesure and seconded by Commissioner Battle that the
Arts Commission hereby approves the recommendation. The motion was carried by the
following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Lesure, Battle, Banks and Metcalf
Noes: None
Noes: None

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  a. Inglewood Transit Connector Lead Artist Update
  b. Utility Box Public Art Project with The Creative House Update
  c. Kia Forum public art removed: Status Update
  d. Inglewood Percent for Art 20th Anniversary book Update
  e. Inglewood Open Studios 2023

PUBLIC REMARKS. Gerard McCallum gave a brief update about the Intuit Dome and
stated that $11 million of public art will be going into the development. Greg Spero of
Tiny Room Studios invited the Commissioners to stop by his Studio.

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. The next Commission meeting is scheduled for January 17, 2024.

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Metcalf declared the
meeting adjourned, at 7:11 p.m.
